description: Manages Bitbucket pipeline known hosts under the “SSH Keys” menu.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: The OAuth consumer key. If not set the environment variable BITBUCKET_CLIENT_ID is used.

parameters.name: client_secret
parameters.description: The OAuth consumer secret. If not set the environment variable BITBUCKET_CLIENT_SECRET is used.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The FQDN of the known host.

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The App password. If not set the environment variable BITBUCKET_PASSWORD is used.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Indicates desired state of the record. Choices: "absent" "present"

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The username. If not set the environment variable BITBUCKET_USERNAME is used. username is an alias of user since community.general 6.0.0. It was an alias of workspace before.

parameters.name: workspace
parameters.description: The repository owner. Note: username used to be an alias of this option. Since community.general 6.0.0 it is an alias of user.

examples:
- name: Create known hosts from the list
  community.general.bitbucket_pipeline_known_host:
    repository: 'bitbucket-repo'
    workspace: bitbucket_workspace
    name: '{{ item }}'
    state: present
  with_items:
    - bitbucket.org
    - example.com

- name: Remove known host
  community.general.bitbucket_pipeline_known_host:
    repository: bitbucket-repo
    workspace: bitbucket_workspace
    name: bitbucket.org
    state: absent

- name: Specify public key file
  community.general.bitbucket_pipeline_known_host:
    repository: bitbucket-repo
    workspace: bitbucket_workspace
    name: bitbucket.org
    key: '{{lookup("file", "bitbucket.pub") }}'
    state: absent
